on_screen_text.text: You have to watch what Donald Trump just said about monitoring women.
That you would support certain states with bans monitoring a woman's pregnancy.
Well, that would be up to the states again.
They will make a decision as to how they do it.
So Donald Trump hand-picked three members of the United States Supreme Court with the intent that they would overturn Roe v. Wade and they did just as he intended.
And he believes that states can monitor women so that they can enforce their Trump Abortion Bans.
Under Trump, it is fair game apparently that states can monitor women.
Whereas Joe Biden and I believe the government should never come between a woman and her doctor.

spoken_summary: Kamala Harris introduces a news clip in which a reporter asks Donald Trump if he supports states with abortion bans "monitoring a woman's pregnancy." Trump responds that it "would be up to the states again." Harris then argues that Trump, who appointed the Supreme Court justices that overturned Roe v. Wade, believes states can monitor women to enforce abortion bans. She contrasts this with her and Joe Biden's belief that the government should not interfere between a woman and her doctor.
audio_music: The audio consists entirely of spoken dialogue from Kamala Harris, a news reporter, and Donald Trump. There is no background music or sound effects.
editing_pacing: The editing uses simple cuts between a static talking-head shot of Kamala Harris and an archival news clip. The pacing is direct and focused on delivering the spoken message.
central_claim: Donald Trump supports states having the power to monitor women's pregnancies to enforce abortion bans.
intended_effect: To cause alarm about Donald Trump's stance on reproductive rights and women's privacy, thereby encouraging votes for the Biden-Harris ticket.
